subject: Dallas Events: October 23–31, 2026
intro: Dallas and North Texas have plenty of ways to get out this week: a city-park Halloween evening, architecture and plant weekends, Mavericks basketball, an AI and finance meetup, and outdoor plans. Check each organizer’s page for current registration and access details before you go.

events.title: Fright or Delight
events.description: An evening event hosted by Dallas Park and Recreation at the Fireside Recreation Center parking lot. Check the city event page for current admission and participation details.

events.title: Pumpkins and Pints: Oktoberfest
events.description: An Oktoberfest-themed evening in Pumpkin Village with live music, bratwurst, pretzels, German sides and desserts. Tickets are required; food and beverages are available for purchase.

events.title: Public Historical Tour
events.description: A free public historical tour hosted by Dallas Park and Recreation at Old City Park.

events.title: Mavericks vs. Spurs
events.description: The Dallas Mavericks host the San Antonio Spurs for the home opener. Doors open at 5:30 PM; check the arena page for ticket availability.

events.title: PlantCon Dallas 2026
events.date: Saturday, Oct 24 at 10:00 AM (also Sunday, Oct 25; 10:00 AM–6:00 PM daily)
events.description: A two-day plant-community event with a 200-booth market, workshops, presentations and exhibitions. General admission runs 10:00 AM–6:00 PM both days; tickets are required.

events.title: AIA Dallas Tour of Homes
events.date: Saturday, Oct 24 at 10:00 AM (also Sunday, Oct 25; 10:00 AM–5:00 PM)
events.venue: Homes across the Dallas–Fort Worth area
events.description: A self-guided architecture tour running 10:00 AM–5:00 PM both days. The organizer shares home addresses with ticket holders; they are not listed here.

events.title: AI, Tech & Finance · Dallas
events.description: An in-person networking evening for people working in AI, technology and finance. The organizer lists the general ticket window through October 28; check the event page for current registration.

events.title: Pumpkins and Pints: Chili Cookoff
events.description: A Halloween-weekend chili-tasting evening with live music and food and drink options. Tickets are required; check the organizer page for current availability.

events.title: Hike and Yoga with Explore More
events.description: A Dallas Park and Recreation Outdoor Adventures program at Samuell (East) Farm in Mesquite. The city lists a $25 fee and requires registration.

events.title: Deep Vellum Books
events.description: An independent bookstore and the storefront for Deep Vellum Books & Publishing, a Dallas nonprofit literary arts organization. Open daily noon–6:00 PM.

events.title: Dallas Area Habitat for Humanity
events.description: Volunteer roles in construction, retail and other areas support affordable homeownership opportunities in the Dallas area. See the organization’s current openings and requirements.
